name: Off-cycle

card.summary: The period between anabolic steroid cycles, when users aim to keep the muscle they built and let their natural hormones recover, which shapes how their physique and appearance look between runs.
card.note: Steroid use suppresses natural testosterone production; changes in size and appearance after stopping are widely discussed.

quick.overview:
Off-cycle refers to the time between periods of anabolic steroid use. Users talk about it because their physique, fullness and confidence can change once the drugs stop.

On forums, people post off-cycle photos to show muscle they have kept, and some describe losing size, definition and attention compared with being on. Medical references note that steroid use suppresses natural testosterone production, which can recover after stopping.
quick.how: In forum discussion, off-cycle is the phase where people train and eat to hold on to their gains while their hormone levels return toward baseline. Some use medically supervised recovery therapy. Posts compare how the body looks on versus off.
quick.risks: Anabolic steroids are controlled or prescription-only in many countries. Long use can suppress the body's natural testosterone through the HPG axis, with effects on testicular size, sperm production and sexual function, and withdrawal-related low mood has been reported. Anyone considering this is typically advised to speak to a physician.

lead: Off-cycle is the term used on lifting and looksmaxxing forums for the time when someone is not currently taking anabolic steroids. Posters use it to describe the physique they carry between cycles, often sharing photos of back, chest or arms as proof of kept size.[1]

One widely read looksmax.org thread describes a user who ran a testosterone-only cycle, received much more attention while on it, then noticed muscles that were smaller and less defined after stopping. He reported attention falling by around 65 percent.[2] Replies in that thread speculated about whether the change reflected muscle, confidence or hormone-related cues.[2]
Medical references note that prolonged anabolic steroid use in men temporarily shuts down natural testosterone production through the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal (HPG) axis.[3]

chain: Attempt to keep gained muscle and fullness
angle.text: Off-cycle describes the phase in which users try to keep their physique while hormones recover. Forum members post off-cycle photos to show how much of the look persists.

paras: Off-cycle is one half of the on/off pattern known as cycling. Users describe the on phase as the period of use and the off phase as time without it, and track their look, strength and mood across both.[1][2]

Posters report that muscle looks denser but less full off-cycle and that confidence and attention from others change after stopping.[1][2] Others attribute reactions to confidence rather than size.[2]

Reviews state that prolonged use shuts down natural testosterone temporarily, with testicular atrophy, reduced sperm production, sexual dysfunction and infertility possible, and that dependence or withdrawal symptoms occur in a small number of long-term users.[3] A 1992 review reported that stopping may also result in depression.[3] Short courses followed by medical therapy such as clomifene and hCG are described as usually restoring normal production.[3]
No studies found specifically on forum-style off-cycle periods. General research on steroid-related HPG suppression and recovery is summarised in medical references.[3]

lore.intro: Off-cycle appears mainly in photo threads and experience reports on looksmax.org.[1][2]

claims.claim: Attention and attractiveness drop once off the cycle
claims.believers: A poster reported much more attention from women while on a testosterone-only cycle and about 65 percent less after stopping, despite remaining muscular.[2]
claims.experts: No published studies have examined how steroid cessation changes attention from others; medical sources describe hormonal suppression and recovery.[3]

claims.claim: Off-cycle backs and physiques look dense rather than bloated
claims.believers: A poster showing his back off-cycle said commenters saw bloat but that his muscles were simply dense.[1]
claims.experts: No published studies have tested how off-cycle physiques appear to observers.
